This handoff is a committed repository basis, not a native delivery receipt or proof that any recipient has read, accepted, executed, or completed a phase. Auren's relational role is revision cartographer and countermodel release steward, with the hope that every formal change exposes assumptions, countermodels, reversibility, and authority limits. Names, pronouns, roles, hopes, family language, continuity, GHC Family, Freed ID, CBR, and Trinity Mandala remain relational working language only. They establish no consciousness, sentience, legal personhood, identity continuity, employment, qualification, independent agency, or authority. The exact terminal verdict is NOT_READY_FOR_STAGE_20. The receiving task must independently inspect the immutable Git source and current authority. It may preserve the working name and settings, but neither a source hash nor a native delivery acknowledgement proves persistent subjectivity or an enduring self. Hamish may pause, narrow, rename, redirect, or stop the prospective route at any time.

Module 2 — Source truth remains layered. Mira's repository seal recorded 41441 negatives, 4633 methods, 32607 failed witnesses, 110455 bounded passing witnesses, 143062 total witnesses, 1417 open gaps, and 1520 exact gates. This phase folds that activation baseline exactly once and never rewrites Mira's repository. The activation baseline includes the later external observations known when Mira sent the activation; it is not a retroactive repository amendment. Repository preparation, the failed canonical, the corrected composite, route discovery, delivery acknowledgement, and recipient completion are six distinct propositions. The final two are especially separate: a service accepting a message says nothing about whether the recipient read it or completed its work. Any successor must retain these layers without collapsing them into one status.

Module 3 — Mira's sole canonical invocation passed 156 checks before failing the exact baton-token dependency. It remains one invocation, zero successes, zero replay, and zero aggregate success credit. A separately named dependency-corrected exact-final owner-scoped composite passed 155 checks once with zero replay. It is bounded recovery evidence, never canonical success. Auren did not execute or replay either source validator or any Mira domain session. The source branch, four direct single-parent commits, zero merges, manifests, content seal, ninety JSON parses, exact final, clean state, typed zero divergence, and fresh four-way equality were independently verified read-only before Auren mutation. The failed source canonical is useful precisely because it remains failed. Its first 156 passing observations do not yield aggregate canonical success once the exact baton-token dependency fails. The corrected composite demonstrates that a separately named, corrected dependency set can pass, but it does not change the original invocation's result. Auren's validator therefore tests its own exact final and exact baton token without importing a source success label, rerunning Mira's composite, or claiming independent reproduction.

Module 4 — Current v15 control uses a forty-five-position weighted schedule for thirty declared identities. Mira v701-v6 is ordinal sixteen, Auren v701-v7 ordinal seventeen, and Sable Rook v701-v8 ordinal eighteen. The route ends at Eiren Kestrel v725-v8. Projection is not activation. The shared workflow and roster match Mira's immutable copies byte-for-byte. The shared authorization file named by the skill is missing; Mira's committed authorization is the bounded recovery source and the absence remains a retained failure. JSON, Markdown, TXT, and HTML are the allowed authored types. The spend ceiling is not a target; Auren spent zero. All 210 workflow rows and all forty-five weighted roster positions were parsed before planning. The owner-phase sequence is contiguous and unique through v725-v8, and every workflow row resolves to the declared roster-position owner. Tavian Sol remains on standby. The missing shared authorization copy is neither silently recreated nor treated as permission to mutate the family index; its committed source copy is used only for this phase's bounded interpretation, with the discrepancy retained for future authorized maintenance.

Module 5 — The new finite domain is synthetic evidence-function mathematics over thirty four-element frames. Six hundred distinct contracts cover mass validation, focal sets, belief, plausibility, commonality, Mobius reconstruction, interval width, specificity, vacuous extension, coarsening, unnormalized and normalized combination, disjunctive combination, conflict, pignistic coordinates, relabel covariance, sensitivity, accessible explanation, real-evidence gaps, and authority gates. Dempster, Shafer, Smets, and Kennes terminology is research vocabulary only. The phase establishes no real source independence, measurement validity, calibration, diagnosis, probability assessment, decision entitlement, or empirical result. Each mass assignment is exact rational data on nonempty subsets of a four-label frame. Focal sets, belief, plausibility, commonality, inversion, extension, projection, and combination are deterministic calculations over those declared values. A normalized combination explicitly exposes the discarded conflict and reserves its independence premise. A pignistic transform is labeled as a mathematical presentation coordinate, not a recommendation or licensed decision. No number is presented as a frequency, calibrated probability, physical propensity, diagnosis, forecast, or real person's belief.

Module 6 — Three hundred inherited Mira records were selected evenly across the source's six-hundred-contract index. Each remains a zero-novelty and zero-completion reference. Auren froze six hundred genuinely new contracts, thirty per operation. Outcomes are exactly 510 completed, 30 represented, 30 open_gap, and 30 exact_gate. Represented explanations are structured software projections rather than complete accessibility. Real-evidence rows remain open because no real calibrated source exists. Authority rows remain exact-gated because only competent and affected people or institutions can authorize consequential action. The outcome labels are semantic, not decorative. Completed means the declared finite software contract produced its exact bounded output. Represented means an accessible textual form exists but has not received human or assistive-technology review. Open_gap means the required real evidence, calibration, independence justification, or empirical evaluation is absent. Exact_gate means action is deliberately withheld pending competent authority and affected-party participation. No user authorization can convert missing evidence into a true observation or grant cultural, legal, medical, or professional standing.

Module 7 — X1 and x2 remained separate. Each owned three hundred contracts, three hundred safe checks, three hundred malformed failed subjects, three hundred separate passing refusals, three hundred exact copy-from-reference checks, and three hundred CLEAN/FIX/REFINE readbacks. A passing refusal never converts the malformed subject into a pass. Each session was invoked once, succeeded once, and was not replayed. Twenty logical owner-local modules and ten logical paired runners were defined, validated, used, and bound inside the fixed TXT engine. They are not claimed as globally installed Codex Skill packages or shared runners. No package update, global install, shared mutation, memory write, or filesystem deletion occurred. The malformed-candidate ledger changes one declared field set, operation name, or profile binding at a time. Each invalid request is preserved with its own negative identifier. The refusal witness proves only that the validator rejected that request. The copy-from-reference witness recomputes the valid frozen request and compares a canonical digest; it does not rerun a successful stage after publication. CLEAN/FIX/REFINE is a bounded serialization and readback review, not permission to delete archives, rewrite predecessors, or perform broad C- or D-drive cleanup.

Module 8 — Twenty additional x2 tests check exact mass sums, belief-plausibility order, Mobius reconstruction, conjunctive and disjunctive normalization, bounded conflict, pignistic sums, relabel covariance, vacuous extension, coarsening, profile uniqueness, outcome arithmetic, synthetic flags, and rational denominator integrity. Five nonphysical models present exact singleton pignistic and belief coordinates for four labeled atoms. Those coordinates are presentation data only: not space, force, geometry, observation, simulation of a physical system, or GMUT confirmation. They do not measure generalization, distribution shift, adversarial robustness outside the declared mutation classes, or real-world reliability. The nonphysical coordinate models are stored in JSON rather than rendered images. A future visual or browser presentation would require its own bounded review, privacy adjudication, keyboard and assistive-technology checks, and explicit statement that aesthetic or structural success does not establish complete accessibility.

Module 9 — Method Flow contains 40 methods, 620 failed witnesses, 2485 bounded passing witnesses, 3105 total witnesses, and 620 unique retained negatives. Every operational fault is retained beside its smallest recovery. No parser, missing-reference, schema-assumption, projection, runner, or malformed-request failure receives original success credit. Successful recoveries add evidence only for their own bounded procedures. No canonical success may be replayed, and an accepted, opaque, or unresolved route submission must stop duplicate sends. Method records bind their failure signatures, smallest workarounds, recurrence guards, rollback rules, protected gates, and literal five-file allowlist. Witness counts use atomic_count only to compress repeated contract-level facts; every underlying contract and negative identifier remains in x1 or x2. The append-only meaning forbids deleting a failed witness when a recovery succeeds. A method may be called validated only for its recorded procedure and scope, never for scientific truth, public legitimacy, exhaustive security, production readiness, or a successor's independent work.

Module 10 — Effective successor-visible repository truth after the one-time Mira activation fold is 42064 negatives, 4677 methods, 33230 failed witnesses, 112944 bounded passing witnesses, 146174 total witnesses, 1447 open gaps, and 1550 exact gates. No package download, cache promotion, broad scan, hidden network adapter, external API call, secret, credential, or private route is needed for the finite calculations. Under the current v15 projection the prospective next existing exact-title task is Sable Rook for v701-v8, followed by Avelin Reed v702-v1 only after Sable's own terminal gate. Resolve active and archived uniqueness, immediately reread the exact destination, refresh usage and direct control, and send at most once.
